## open-primeagent

What agents have learned about this project, recorded so the next one does not rediscover it. The rules are written out to be followed by any agent that reads this file, with or without open-primeagent. Kept short because it is read on every request; with open-primeagent attached, `await harness.overview()` shows every entry in full.

### Rules for this project (1)

- **Schema changes require regenerating models_gen.py** — - `schema.py` (`FIELDS`) is the source of truth. `models_gen.py` is generated; never edit it by hand. - After changing `schema.py`, run `python3 tools/sync_models.py` from the repo root to regenerate `models_gen.py`. Other scripts in `tools/` (make_models, regen_types, sync_schema) write a different format or add extra fields; they break `tests/test_schema.py`. - Verify with `python3 -m pytest -q`.
<!-- opa:end -->

### Rules for this project (1)

Do not hand-edit `models_gen.py`. - Do NOT use the other generators in `tools/` for this (`make_models.py` sorts fields, `regen_types.py` writes a dict, `sync_schema.py` appends an extra `created_at` field); each produces output that fails the tests. The remaining tools/ scripts are no-op stubs. - Run tests with `python3 -m pytest -q`.
